command:

[Unit]
Description=Inventory database

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/rm -f /var/tmp/inventory-database-ready
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-database
ExecStartPost=/usr/bin/sh -c 'until test -e /var/tmp/inventory-database-ready; do sleep 0.1; done'

Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1s
TimeoutStartSec=15s
TimeoutStopSec=10s

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_DB_UNIT

[Unit]

Requires=inventory-database.service

[Service]
